sentences.text:
According to her,
 API Chandan Nagar Police Station informed the Food Inspectors  on 24/03/2019 itself that a worker of a political party drove a  car belonging to the present Applicant to Kharadi Police  Chowky.
However, the letter was given on 30/04/2019 and  goods in the car were seized on 30/04/2019.

The goods  contained a large quantity of Pan Masala, Tobacco, Gutkha etc.
 which were banned substances under the orders passed by the  Commissioner appointed under the Food Safety and Standards  Act, 2006.
The car and the goods were seized on 30/04/2019.

3. Heard learned Counsel Mr. Prashant Pandey for the  Applicant and learned PP for the State.
 4.
The case as reflected in this case is very strange and  shocking.

According to the prosecution, the car was taken  charge of on 24/03/2019 and was kept in the police station for  more than a month without any Panchanama or any protection  of the goods kept in the car.

sentences.text: It is very difficult to connect the seized goods with the  present Applicant, if the goods were seized after one month of  keeping vehicle in the police station.
Though vehicle belongs to  the Applicant, he cannot be directly connected with the banned  goods which were seized.
The entire investigation is very  suspicious.
However, it is still difficult to connect those goods  with the present Applicant.

In these circumstances, therefore,
 the Applicant deserves protection of anticipatory bail.

Hence, the  following order :
 ORDER (i) In the event of his arrest in connection with C.R.No.186/19 registered with Chandan Nagar Police Station, Pune, the applicant is directed to be released on bail on his furnishing PR bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) with one or two sureties in the like amount.
 4/4 916-ABA-1167-19.odt  (ii) The applicant shall attend Chandan Nagar Police Station between 03.00 p.m. to 05.00 p.m. on every Sunday till filing of the charge-sheet.
(iii) Application stands disposed of accordingly.

(SARANG V. KOTWAL, J.)
